integrity: Two standalone complete Python programs with distinct enumeration methods accompany the proof. Correctness, originality, and value were reviewed during self-review. External independent validation and external scholarly audit were not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the two specified cubic ladder families and single Hamiltonian-preserving two-edge switches for every integer n >= 5. Known static cycle counts are not original; 1998 historical full text could not be obtained and may include equivalent switch observations. Finite computations corroborate but do not replace the infinite proof.
title: A topological twist changes Hamiltonian two-edge-switch mobility from isolated states to a star
